subject: Possible
audience: Builders who have a rough ambition but need a trustworthy definition of done.
purpose: Explain what Possible is and why an Outcome Pack is different from an unconstrained build prompt.
format: 1280x720 MP4, 30 fps, H.264 video with AAC audio
claimsBoundary: Possible is an open-source library of Outcome Packs for Codex.
An Outcome Pack combines an execution prompt, selected agent skills, sequencing, safeguards, and completion checks.
The preserved Robot Snake run produced CAD, URDF/SRDF, MuJoCo control, obstacle avoidance, and Rerun telemetry.
Fresh verification caught and repaired three defects; the final suite passed 12/12 tests and 186/186 interface checks.
Possible recommends one outcome at a time and does not authorize external actions by itself.
nonClaims: No claim of customer demand, commercial effectiveness, deployment, or audience response.
No claim that a renderer or audio provider was available when it was not.
